Two DualShock 4 controllers are shown; one is black, the other has a colorful paint-splatter skin.
A power adapter with a UK-style three-pin plug is visible.
A small piece of paper, likely a receipt or warranty card, is tucked under the controllers.

The storage capacity cannot be determined from the photos.

There is no video or screenshot showing the console booting to the home screen or running a game.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
